Subject: Micro-case briefs and short demo clips for booth

Connor —

Thanks again for the chat this morning. As we finalize the plan for Acme’s booth at CloudSummit, we wanted to confirm deliverables and timelines from Redwood:

- Three micro-case one-pagers (customer problem, how Redwood helped, 3 metrics) for print and PDF (two-column).
- A 60s hero demo + two 30s variant clips (MP4) showing: onboarding, latency/cost summary, and a quick query demo.
- A one-slide technical snapshot for our engineers to pin on the wall.

Can you confirm you can deliver drafts by Nov 9 so we can get design edits and get the assets to our AV partner by Nov 12? Also need final print-ready PDFs by Nov 16.

Mike at StudioFlux will handle the edit pack — I’ll loop him in on any raw clips. Are there example case studies/BAU customer quotes we can reuse?

Thanks,
Sara
Product Marketing, Acme Cloud

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Micro-case briefs and short demo clips for booth

Team — looping you in. Sara wants a tight set of deliverables on a short timeline. Proposed split: 

- Laura: own the micro-case one-pagers (3). Use the structure: 1) challenge 2) where Redwood fit 3) measurable outcome + quote. Aim for two versions: print PDF and web copy.
- Ben: own video shots and rough cuts. Capture 1x60s + 2x30s. Need raw recorder notes, timestamped scripts. Coordinate with Mike for edit specs (frame size, LUT preferences).
- Irene: technical one-slide + 2 short bullet callouts for the booth panel. Include latency numbers, typical batch sizes, and routing note.

Deadlines: first drafts by EOD Nov 9 (we have 6 days). Final print-ready by Nov 16. If any blockers, call them out by Nov 6 EOD.

Don’t reinvent the wheel — reuse the customer metrics from the Acme pilot case study (linked below). I’ve added a Google Doc and the Figma board for layout.

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aXc-example-microcase-brief  |  https://www.figma.com/file/Example/Acme-Booth-Assets

Attachments: placeholder_shotlist.txt (I’ll upload a better version later)

Thanks — Connor
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
